design_name: Coverage-matched Caltech-to-OBELiX reverse ionic borrowing screen
claim_guard: The Caltech and OBELiX outcomes were used in earlier analyses, but this reverse source-to-target edge and coverage-aware implementation were chosen after the new source-coverage audit and before this local outcome model. It is method development, not independent confirmation.
physical_contract: same experimental endpoint across two solid-electrolyte databases

source_selection_evidence_without_target.coverage_definition: nearest source distance no larger than the 95th percentile of target-development leave-one-out nearest-neighbor distance in target-development-standardized composition features

leakage_exclusion.shared_doi: remove every Caltech row whose normalized DOI occurs anywhere in OBELiX
leakage_exclusion.target_evaluation_identity: remove every Caltech row matching any frozen OBELiX evaluation composition
leakage_exclusion.target_training_identity: for each target draw, also remove every Caltech row matching a sampled target-training composition

evaluation.primary: Q4 relative RMSE gain of coverage-aware borrowing versus target-only
evaluation.controls: zero-coverage physical neighbor and shuffled source
evaluation.escalation: positive Q4 gain and specificity, positive Q4 R2, and superiority to both controls across at least two target learners
